name: GhostPopover
description: Headless non-modal disclosure and popover root provider. Manages controlled/uncontrolled open state via useControllableState and deterministic trigger/content IDs via useGhostId.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is omitted.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Trigger and content parts plus optional custom UI reading the scoped state.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Floating dialog surface rendered by GhostPopoverContent.

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state while the popover is open.

states.name: closed
states.description: Applied on GhostPopoverTrigger data-state while the popover is closed.

keyboard.Enter: Toggles the popover on GhostPopoverTrigger or closes on GhostPopoverClose.
keyboard.Space: Toggles the popover on GhostPopoverTrigger or closes on GhostPopoverClose.
keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the topmost open popover and restores focus to the trigger.
